text:
Little drop, my pain.

I threw it into the sea.

Into the deep sea.

Then I said to myself: To your liking

you may now sail!


But my little faith undid me...

The little faith

of my singing.

Between wave and sky I was shipwrecked.


And the sea was an immense pain.

translation.title: Little Drop, My Pain
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the miniature pain cast into the sea and returning as immensity.
